def f(g):
    import numpy as np
    a=np.array(g); h,w=a.shape
    # detect stripe orientation: do colors vary along rows (vertical stripes) or cols?
    var_row = not all(set(r)=={a[i][0]} for i in range(h))
    if var_row:
        # vertical stripes: color = c[i][0], repeat cyclically
        col=[r[0] for r in a]; return [[col[j%len(col)] for _ in range(w)] for j in range(h)]
    else:
        # horizontal stripes
        row=[a[i][0] for i in range(h)]
        return [[row[i%len(row)] for _ in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
